email.subject: Pistons Co Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Pistons Co Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book online, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so anyone searching on their phone has to copy down a number and call later (or just move to the next shop). On top of that, there are no reviews showing, which makes new visitors less confident choosing you over a competitor.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
